# Alex Klick - Resume

## Summary

AI/LLM engineer with 4+ years delivering production RAG and document intelligence
systems in enterprise and regulated biopharma environments. Combines strong Python
backend execution with practical LLM architecture, vector retrieval, and
cross-functional product delivery.

## Skills

**Languages & Frameworks:** Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, JavaScript/TypeScript
**AI/ML:** OpenAI API, sentence transformers, RAG pipelines, embeddings, reranking
**Data & Infrastructure:** PostgreSQL, pgvector, Chroma, Redis, Docker
**Document Processing:** PDF chunking, RTF parsing, document ingestion

## Professional Experience

### Senior Consultant — Credera (2022–Present)

- Built vector database and reranker systems serving 30,000+ documents for enterprise teams
- Designed sub-section PDF chunking pipelines for biopharma regulatory workflows at Fortune-200 scale
- Shipped modular agent components adopted by 100+ users and expanded toward 300+ enterprise users
- Led model-quality evaluation for sentence-transformer rerankers and deployed at production scale
- Built RTF processing capabilities to extract complex clinical table data for downstream workflows
- Mentored three junior engineers on agentic workflow reliability and performance practices

### Backend Engineer — Turing School Projects (2021–2022)

- Developed RESTful APIs using Ruby on Rails and Python/FastAPI
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments
- Collaborated on cross-functional teams delivering MVPs under tight deadlines

## Education

- Turing School of Software & Design — Backend Engineering (2021)
- Eastern Michigan University — Economics & Mathematics (2017)

at MCG Health. With over four years of experience building production RAG and document
intelligence systems in regulated healthcare environments, I bring both the technical
depth and domain awareness that this role demands.

## Role Alignment

- Built enterprise-scale vector database and reranker systems serving 30,000+ documents,
  directly applicable to MCG's clinical evidence retrieval needs
- Designed sub-section PDF chunking pipelines for biopharma regulatory workflows,
  aligning with MCG's document processing requirements
- Strong Python/FastAPI backend with OpenAI API integration, matching the role's
  technology stack requirements
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and collaborating across product, design,
  and analyst teams

## Evidence Highlights

- Shipped modular agent components adopted by 100+ users with expansion to 300+ enterprise users
- Led evaluation and deployment of sentence-transformer rerankers at production scale
- Built RTF processing capabilities for complex clinical table data extraction
- Designed document ingestion pipelines serving Fortune-200 biopharma workflows

## Closing

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building AI-powered
document intelligence systems can contribute to MCG Health's mission of delivering
evidence-based healthcare solutions. I am available for a conversation at your
earliest convenience.
rationale: Strong fact-grounded generation targeting MCG Health requirements.
